islam.title: Islam
islam.description: Islam is one of the world's largest religions, based on belief in one God and values such as peace, mercy, justice, and humanity.
islam.history: Islam emerged in the 7th century in the Arabian Peninsula. Its teachings are based on the Quran and the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad.
islam.beliefs_description: Islam includes belief in one God, prophets, holy books, angels, the Day of Judgment, and divine decree.
islam.places_description: Mecca, Medina, and Jerusalem hold important significance in Islam.
islam.culture_description: Islamic culture has contributed to science, architecture, literature, art, hospitality, and respect for others.

christianity.title: Christianity
christianity.description: Christianity is one of the world's largest religions, based on the teachings of Jesus Christ.
christianity.history: Christianity originated in the 1st century in the Roman Empire and later spread throughout many parts of the world.
christianity.beliefs_description: Christianity's main teachings focus on faith in God, Jesus Christ, love, forgiveness, and helping others.
christianity.places_description: Jerusalem, Bethlehem, and the Vatican are important places in Christian history.
christianity.culture_description: Christian culture has made significant contributions to art, music, architecture, education, and literature.

buddhism.title: Buddhism
buddhism.description: Buddhism is a religious and philosophical teaching focused on spiritual development, wisdom, peace, and compassion.
buddhism.history: Buddhism developed around the 6th–5th centuries BCE in India based on the teachings of Siddhartha Gautama.
buddhism.beliefs_description: Buddhism focuses on understanding life, suffering, its causes, and the path to liberation, as well as mindfulness and compassion.
buddhism.places_description: Lumbini, Bodh Gaya, Sarnath, and Kushinagar are important places in Buddhist history.
buddhism.culture_description: Buddhist culture is known for meditation, art, architecture, philosophy, and values of peace.
